value.rationale: The natural decision is which one individual or site to protect when two star-like communities communicate by a corridor. The result gives the complete optimum for all transmissibilities, reveals a degree-hub versus bottleneck-center reversal and characterizes existence of a reversal by a sharp community-size/corridor-length inequality. This is stronger than recomputing a finite graph table and directly distinguishes finite expected outbreaks from giant-component surrogates.
